A '''battle''' took place in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] in the [[Saari Ha system|Bimmisaari system]] during [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] and his [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Atlas" />
